cameraListIndex.description: Index of the camera in the DCAM-enumerated list (0-based), or any string to force the mock fallback. Shipped setups use both; nothing narrower is accepted.

hamamatsu.description: Dictionary of DCAM API property name → value pairs applied via ``setPropertyValue`` at startup.

mockRandomSeed.description: Simulation only: seed of the ``mockSample`` frames' camera noise, for reproducible mock recordings.  ``None`` draws fresh noise every run.

mockSample.description: Simulation only (mock camera on a simulated NI-DAQ): the frames show the virtual sample under a square MoNaLISA foci lattice fixed on the camera, the sample moved by the stage position the scan waveforms give at each camera trigger. ``{"axes": {"<x device>": <µm per V>, "<y device>": <µm per V>}, "latticePeriodUm": 0.72, "seed": 0}``; each axis carries its positioner's ``conversionFactor``. Optional: the point-scan keys (``preset``, ``zAxis``, ``bleachHalfLifeS``), ``excitation`` (readout lasers, with ``saturationPower``/``scatterBackground``), ``switching`` (ON/OFF lasers, RESOLFT), ``excitationFwhmUm``, ``spotSigmaUm``, ``peakCounts``, ``offsetCounts`` and ``readNoiseCounts``; see :doc:`../mock-infrastructure`. Without it the mock frames are uniform noise.
